<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 1 consists of two resistors in series between terminals A and X1, where one resistor is twice the value of the other. Let R be the smaller resistor; then total resistance = R + 2R = 3R = 6.667 Ω, giving R ≈ 2.222 Ω and 2R ≈ 4.445 Ω. The series connection can be represented with an intermediate node (e.g., “B”).</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.445}, "connections": [["A","B","R1"], ["B","X1","R2"]]}</final_answer>
